twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.chooseSubtitle: Choose how you want to finish signing in:
twoFactor.totpMethodDescription: Enter the 6-digit code your app is showing right now
twoFactor.recoveryMethodDescription: One of the codes you saved when you set two-factor authentication up
twoFactor.totpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.recoverySubtitle: Enter one of your saved recovery codes. Each code works once.

twoFactor.recoveryHelp: Format XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX. Each recovery code works once.
twoFactor.totpIncomplete: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

twoFactorEnrollment.title: Set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorEnrollment.warning: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up now to keep access to your account.
twoFactorEnrollment.deadlineWarning: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up by {{date}} to keep access to your account.
twoFactorEnrollment.passkeyNote: A registered passkey also satisfies this requirement — if you already use one to sign in, you do not need an authenticator app as well.
twoFactorEnrollment.blocked: Your role requires two-factor authentication and the setup deadline has passed. Ask an administrator to help you finish setting it up.
